تصطنعون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَنِعُونَ (taṣṭaniʕūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.ni.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# تُصْطَنَعُونَ (tuṣṭanaʕūna) /tusˤ.tˤa.na.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
